resource_risks.description: Stable scrollbar gutter can reduce nav client width below button width and create horizontal overflow.
resource_risks.mitigation: Set activity rail nav overflow-x hidden, overflow-y auto, scrollbar-gutter auto, and constrain button width to min(100%, 58px).
evidence: Browser smoke after fix: navClientWidth=59 and navScrollWidth=59 at 1280x720
Browser smoke short viewport: navClientWidth=48 and navScrollWidth=48 at 1280x520

resource_risks.description: Temporary viewport override could leak into later browser work.
resource_risks.mitigation: Reset Browser viewport after short-height smoke.

resource_risks.description: Browser smoke uses a local Next.js development server that must be stopped.
resource_risks.mitigation: Serve on dedicated local port 3231, close the Browser tab, stop the server, and verify no listener remains.
